title: The Dashboard always shows the same tiles in the same order
custom_preconds: 1. You are signed in as an owner/admin (or any user with the Reports permission) on the build under test; a single workplace is selected.
custom_steps:
1. Open the dashboard and confirm the top row shows four KPI tiles left to right: Revenue, Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization.
2. Confirm the row below shows two count tiles left to right: Sales by Customer, At Risk Customers.
3. Sign in as a different user and confirm the same tile set and order, and that all six tiles are shown to every user who can open the dashboard.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The four KPI tiles sit in a fixed top row, left to right: Revenue, Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization.
  • The two count tiles sit below the KPI row, left to right: Sales by Customer, At Risk Customers.
  • The tile set and order are the same for every user.
  • Every user who can open the dashboard sees all six tiles.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9574 (S2 — One Fixed Layout); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S2; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R1: “The dashboard shows the four KPI tiles in a fixed top row, left to right: Revenue, Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization.”
  • S2-R2: “The dashboard shows the two count tiles below the KPI row, left to right: Sales by Customer, At Risk Customers.”
  • S2-R3: “The tile set and their order are the same for every user.”
  • S2-R4: “Every user who can open the dashboard sees all six tiles.”
